Parapets and slab edges around the stair void and the double-height void (WALL lines at y 21.16-21.36, x 99.06-99.12, y 23.11-23.16; FLOOR/HATCH edges at y 19.26-19.41 and x 98.97-99.12) are edges of voids, not openings.
Pebbles drawn as WALL-layer polylines and a tree symbol (x 95-106, y 11.4-14.3) are garden landscaping seen below.
D-JAMB double lines along the west wing's south edge (y 7.41-7.43, x 82.62-88.47) and around the piers at x 93.22-93.57 are edge or cladding outlines, not jambs of an opening.
These closed boxes are solid: duct boxes with an X (82.02-82.82 x 15.46-15.76 and 87.87-88.17 x 23.56-24.56), the shaft (86.37-86.87 x 15.86-16.61) and the shower shelf (81.87-83.07 x 14.96-15.36).
The corridor's east wall from y 12.76 to 15.76 is drawn only 0.10 thick (x 88.32-88.42), with FLOOR lines at 88.17/88.27. It is continuous, with no gap.

method: I worked from pictures first, then confirmed every candidate from the geometry. (1) I rendered the whole part (overview.png, 1 m grid, inserts) and the full upper floor for context. (2) I rendered 12 zoomed tiles at a 0.5 m grid with inserts and text: x 81-87.3, 86.7-93.3, 92.7-99.3 and 98.7-105.5 crossed with y 6.5-13, 12.5-19 and 18.5-25.5 (tile_1..12). I followed every wall line in each tile. Extra zooms covered the bathroom entrance, dressing room, east corridor, both bedroom glazings and the sliding-door area. (3) I checked each candidate in prims.pkl with small query scripts in my folder (q.py, walls.py, lay.py, ins.py). Checked items: wall-layer segment end points along each line; WIN, WALL-GL and D-JAMB frame pieces; door blocks (*U31 at the bridge, the XR_L44 Plan shower-door block); DOOR-layer sliding panels and their pockets. The upper plan is block hjhjj plus top-level WALL edits (dressing stub, portal box, bathroom recess box, shower screen), and I read all of them. (4) I measured a and b on the wall centre line at the wall-end faces, frames included, and took the thickness from the wall lines. (5) Window versus full-height glazing: the sheet's left 'elevation' (x 6-29, y 43.5-60; 1:50, levels +0.90/+4.80/+7.90) is a section through the bridge looking east, with the bridge (y 19.32-21.27) at sheet x 13.7-18.2. It shows the bridge sides, the stair-hall glass and the void curtain wall floor to ceiling at the upper level, so those went to glassWalls. I found no elevation of the west wing's faces or of the south window band (the right elevation's ground floor does not match the wing), so those windows are rated low. (6) Final check: a marked overview plus 4 marked check tiles (wing north, wing south, main building west, main building east). A script confirmed that every WIN, WALL-GL, D-JAMB and DOOR segment in the part lies within 0.25 m of a listed opening or glass wall. The only exceptions are pier cladding, the south-edge D-JAMB outline and sliding-panel parts inside pockets. Every arc in the part is accounted for: the bridge double door, the shower door, the portal-box leaves, and furniture or the tree symbol.
